products.name: Riviera Tailored Linen Shirt
products.description: Meticulously crafted from 100% European flax linen. Breathable, relaxed tailoring with mother-of-pearl buttons, ideal for refined tropical elegance.

products.name: Milano Full-Grain Leather Weekender
products.description: Handcrafted from vegetable-tanned full-grain cognac leather. Features antique brass hardware, reinforced luggage handles, and spacious waterproof lined interior.

products.name: Geneva Gold Minimalist Watch
products.description: Ultra-slim surgical-grade champagne gold casing with scratch-resistant sapphire crystal and Italian top-grain calfskin leather strap. Accurate Swiss quartz movement.

products.name: Aura Pro Studio Wireless Headphones
products.description: Precision 40mm titanium acoustic drivers, hybrid active noise cancellation, brushed aluminum hardware, and 45-hour ultra-long battery life with spatial audio.

products.name: PulseTrack OLED Smart Fitness Band
products.description: Vibrant curved 1.47-inch AMOLED display with real-time biometric heart rate, SpO2 monitoring, 50m water resistance, and 14-day endurance battery.

products.name: Nordic Ceramic Sculptural Table Lamp
products.description: Hand-thrown matte textured stoneware ceramic base complemented by a natural woven linen shade. Emits warm ambient illumination for serene interiors.

products.name: Botanical Amber Soy Scented Candle
products.description: Poured with 100% organic soy wax and natural wooden wick in an apothecary amber glass vessel. Infused with cedarwood, vanilla amber, and bergamot essential oils.

products.name: Lumière 20% Vitamin C Radiance Serum
products.description: Advanced antioxidant brightening elixir formulated with 20% stabilized L-Ascorbic Acid, pure hyaluronic acid, and botanical ferulic acid for a luminous, firm complexion.

products.name: Sartorial Silk & Cashmere Scarf
products.description: Woven in Como, Italy from 70% pure Mongolian cashmere and 30% Mulberry silk. Reversible emerald and champagne jacquard monogram with hand-twisted eyelash fringe.

products.name: Acoustic Horizon Walnut Hi-Fi Speaker
products.description: Handcrafted solid American walnut enclosure with dual beryllium dome tweeters, acoustic bass reflex port, Bluetooth 5.3 aptX HD, and knurled champagne brass rotary dials.

products.name: Verona Fluted Marble Serving Tray
products.description: Carved from a single solid block of Italian Carrara white marble with fluted scalloped edging and brushed gold spherical brass protective footings. Sealed for water and stain resistance.

products.name: Oud Impérial Eau De Parfum (100ml)
products.description: An intoxicating blend of wild Cambodian agarwood oud, Taif damascene rose, amber resin, and Madagascar vanilla. Encased in a heavy cut-crystal flacon with 24k gold leaf atomizer.

products.name: Monaco Hand-Welted Goodyear Leather Oxford Shoes
products.description: Masterfully hand-welted from full-grain French calfskin with Goodyear-welted oak bark leather soles. Features hand-burnished espresso patina, closed-channel stitching, and brass eyelets for timeless sartorial distinction.

products.name: Obsidian Chrono Smart Ring (Titanium Edition)
products.description: Forged from grade 5 aerospace titanium with an inner inlay of 24k gold leaf. Delivers medical-grade heart rate, sleep phase tracking, skin temperature, and 7-day battery life in a featherlight waterproof design.

products.name: Kyoto Fluted Crystal Decanter & Whiskey Glass Set
products.description: Hand-blown from 24% lead-free sparkling crystal with heavy geometric fluted bases and a precision-ground geometric crystal stopper with 24k gold trimmed neck. Includes two matching weighted tumblers.

products.name: Aurelian Gold 24K Cellular Face Nectar (50ml)
products.description: An opulent nocturnal youth concentrate combining cold-pressed Moroccan prickly pear seed oil, organic rosehip, genuine suspended 24-karat gold leaf flakes, and Bulgarian damask rose otto. Restores cellular luminosity overnight.
